item.description:

The company has previously outlined plans for mass production, proprietary small models, and large-scale computing clusters, reporting a 270% year-over-year increase in net profit.

item.title: OpenAI Launches 'Grid Protectors' to Cut Data Center Power During Grid Overload
item.description:
OpenAI has launched the 'Grid Protectors' program, allowing utilities to remotely reduce data center power consumption during grid peaks. The first agreement with Georgia Power enables cutting up to 1,000MW from the Effingham County campus during demand surges, prioritizing residential supply. This initiative aims to mitigate growing community opposition to data centers while ensuring stable operation of large-scale compute infrastructure.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors 计划 承诺在电网过载时削减数据中心功耗

Why it matters：该事件标志着 AI 算力扩张与公共电网稳定性之间博弈进入制度化协调阶段，对关注基础设施可持续性的读者具有较高参考价值。

item.title: MIT Proposes Weight-Space Programming: GPT-6 Astra Edits Qwen Weights to Boost Math
item.description:
MIT CSAIL researchers introduced 'Weight-Space Programming,' a paradigm where frontier LLMs like GPT-6 Astra directly read and edit neural network weights without gradients or retraining. Experiments showed that modifying just 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights boosted its MATH-500 accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1%, primarily by removing reasoning loops rather than adding new knowledge. This study demonstrates that LLMs can natively manipulate model parameters, offering a new path for AI self-improvement, though results await independent replication.

原文标题：MIT 提出权重空间编程：GPT-6 Astra 直接修改 Qwen 权重提升数学能力

Why it matters：颠覆传统训练范式，展示大模型直接编辑权重的可行性与显著效果，具有极高的技术前瞻性与行业影响力。

item.description:

item.title: LLM CLI v0.37 Adds Multimodal Embeddings and Endpoint Config
item.description:
Simon Willison's LLM CLI tool and Python library released version 0.37, introducing a command to easily configure OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The update switches the default model to the cheaper gpt-6-luna and enhances embedding support for multimodal binary content including text, audio, and images. The author also notes that while the project receives many AI-assisted pull requests, large language models are effectively used to triage and review these contributions.

原文标题：LLM CLI v0.37 发布 支持多模态嵌入与端点配置

Why it matters：开发者常用工具的重要更新，涉及多模态嵌入支持与工作流优化，具备一定实用价值。

item.description:

Despite rising revenues, political headwinds for data centers and unclear monetization paths for cloud giants are driving conservative pricing, making this event a critical test of public market appetite for AI assets.

item.title: WorkOS Breached by Autonomous AI Pen-Testing Framework ARTEX
item.description:
Auth infrastructure provider WorkOS disclosed a security incident driven by ARTEX, an AI-assisted autonomous penetration testing framework. The attacker accessed business contact data from Salesforce and Snowflake via an internal API, though no application data or production services were compromised. This highlights emerging risks posed by autonomous agents in cybersecurity.

This trend suggests that infrastructure spending supporting the AI boom may begin to moderate, indicating the market could be approaching the bubble peak where supply catches up with demand.

item.description:

The process involved approximately 10,000 parallel instances running for four days using a decentralized, hierarchy-free architecture where each instance autonomously chose directions and shared progress.

item.title: Cohere 论文证实投机解码在 MoE 模型低批次下显著提速
item.description:
Cohere 最新研究推翻了“投机解码在混合专家（MoE）模型小批次场景收益有限”的传统观点。实验表明，相邻 Token 的专家路由重合度高达 20%-45%，远超理论预期，使得验证步骤开销极低。在 Qwen3-235B 等模型上，验证速度可达正常解码的 89%，为智能体工作负载提供了高效的推理优化方案。

Why it matters：该研究纠正了 MoE 架构下的推理优化盲区，对降低大模型服务成本具有直接工程价值。

item.title: 前沿大模型直接编辑小模型权重实现数学能力六倍提升
item.description:
